cityKey.label: The Dhaka City band
cityKey.help: Which delivery band is inside the city. Every area of the official city-corporation map below is in it.

subAreaKey.label: The sub-area band
subAreaKey.help: Which delivery band holds your own sub-area list (for example Gazipur, Savar, Narayanganj).

outsideKey.label: The outside band
outsideKey.help: Which delivery band is everywhere else in the country: one flat charge.

cityCorporations.label: City corporations inside the city band
cityCorporations.help: The city is the official map of these city corporations, nothing else. Dhaka: DNCC and DSCC.

searchLimit.label: Places shown in the admin search
searchLimit.help: How many places the admin's place search shows at most (adding a place to the sub-area list).

cacheSeconds.label: Re-check the area list every (seconds)
cacheSeconds.help: The shop keeps the national area list in memory and looks for a newer list this often. A new list is only loaded when it has really changed.
